games.name: SPECTER
games.desc:
Investigate ghosts in haunted locations with your friends. Use your equipment to find paranormal evidence and work out the ghost type, then escape before the ghost hunts you!

Use hiding spots to your advantage, and carefully control your stamina to survive the hunt. If you need more help, read the journal's FAQ section during a match, or check out our server.

⚠️ This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and scary scenes.
⚙️ An extensive settings menu is available in the lobby! Customize your experience to your liking.
🎧 We recommend using headphones for the best experience.
🎙️ Spirit box and the team radio feature support voice chat!
🎵 The lobby music and ambient soundtracks used in SPECTER are original and copyright free, you are free to use them in videos!

Inspired by the horror game Phasmophobia.

games.name: HCBB 9v9 2.0
games.desc:
9v9 Baseball game
Stadium Builders: Various community members

Update:
Added 1v1 game mode.

Say "set park" to change the ballpark you are in (Batting Cages only atm)
All pitches thrown fast with no drag have slight increase in speed
Batter can now right click during swing to check their swing
In VIP Servers, say "bp on" to activate Batting Practice and "bp off" to turn it off
In Batting Practice, press Spacebar to have the pitcher pitch; press 'h' to turn hints on/off; press 'b' to hide/show the strike zone
Catcher can request speed of pitch by left clicking for fast, and right clicking for slow

games.name: generic zombie apoclypse RP
games.desc:
A zombie apocalypse has swept across the world and torn apart society. In the quaint town of Zombloxia, groups of survivors, bandits, and remnants of the military all clash in a struggle for survival. Your story begins here.

This is a lighthearted, lore-light zombie roleplay game styled after early 2010s Roblox.

Controls:
Shift - Sprint
C - Sneak
F - Secondary tool action
V - Lower/raise gun
G - Sit
B - Flop
. - Emotes
